entry.author: Environment Canterbury
entry.summary: Awareness is growing, and it’s changing the outcome. As more landowners get on board, wallaby sightings are being reported faster, allowing teams to respond before animals move on. Clear signage and community involvement are strengthening the programme and delivering real results. The benefits are clear on the ground: less competition for feed, healthier stock, and noticeable improvements across the South Waitaki. When everyone’s on the same page, progress follows.
